## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

## 3.43.Mobile Phones

- Other than in respect of emergency use, mobile phones should be used only in designated areas and/or within offices and welfare/rest areas.Users should be aware of the implications and ramifications of mobilephone use which creates risk tothehealth and safety of themselves and others, and the need to co-operate with their employers and other persons in this area. Personal radios and portable audio equipment are prohibited on any Emaar Misr worksites.
- Emaar Misr will operate a Zero Tolerance policy in relation the use of mobile phones while driving vehicles or operating plant and equipment. Where persons are found to be in breach of the Zero Tolerance policy Emaar Misr reserves the right to request that the violator be removed immediately from all Emaar Misr projects.

## 3.44. Smoking

- Smoking on all Emaar Misr sites is prohibited, except in specific, designated locations which shall exclude all enclosedwork areas including offices and welfare facilities.
- Smoking facilities shall be managed to minimize any fire risk e.g. away from hazardous substance storage areas,be constructed from suitablefire retardant materials,and to avoid creating discomfort or health risk to other personnel and as a minimum represent compliance with any legal requirement toprotectpeoplefrompassivesmoking.
- Appropriatesignage shallbe used toidentifysuchareasand appropriatefirefighting equipment shall be placcd at the designated Smoking areas.

## 3.45.AccidentInvestigation

- All Accidents and incidents,dangerous occurrences,diseases and near misses need to bereported andinvestigated to identifycausation and subsequentlyallow improvement/preventive actions tobe implemented.

## 3.46. Emergency Preparedness

- All offices, projects and worksites shall have adequate emergency arrangements which are known and readily available to those that may rcquirc them. This shall include fire and emergency preparedness and response plans.
- The Plans shall include the Contractor's arrangements for dealing with reasonably foreseeable contingencies, addressing:
- ·Notifications and reporting, including notification as soon as possible to EMAAR Misr
- ·Arrangements to mitigate any Incident (including occupational health events), minimizing harm arising
- Recovery arrangements
- Investigations, detailed report preparation and learning
- Participating in training exercises, desktop and drills to ensure emergency response preparedness is effective
